prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Here is how to interact with your pet anytime on your desktop.", "Click to pet, double-click to hide, hold Space to speak", "Launch Pet to Desktop"]
1: ["Meet Your New Pet Preview", "Review your companion appearance and personality traits before finalizing.", "3D Companion Model", "Proceed to Certificate"]
2: ["Signing in automatically restores your existing desktop pets and custom assets.", "Existing Pets Auto-Restored"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet Desktop Environment", "Ensuring display overlay and desktop engine compatibility...", "Configuring Desktop Overlay Engine"]
4: []
5: ["Checking Photo Quality", "We are verifying lighting and resolution to ensure great 3D pet generation.", "Face clarity, lighting, background separation verified", "Looks Good, Continue"]
6: ["Welcome Pack Unlocked!", "Your pet is ready for your desktop. Claim your free starter toy accessory now.", "Bonus: Free Desktop Toy Unlocked"]
7: ["Quick Account Sign-In", "Sign in with one click to keep your pet save files protected.", "Sign In to Save Pet"]
8: ["We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to spawn.", "Desktop Notification Enabled"]
9: ["Choose How to Create Your Desktop Pet", "Pick a ready-to-play companion instant model or generate a unique custom pet from your own photos.", "You can always create additional pets later."]
